subject: Important Update: Changes to Billing System
body: Dear Valued Customer, We wanted to inform you about some upcoming changes to our billing system. Starting next month, we will be transitioning to a new platform to improve efficiency and accuracy. You may notice some slight changes in the billing process, but rest assured that our team is here to assist you every step of the way. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for your continued support. Sincerely, The Billing Team
